summary_1line: Dhaumya consoles the anxious Pandavas by describing sacred eastern pilgrimage sites—Naimisha, Gaya, Prayaga, and others—promising merit from hearing of or visiting them.

image_candidates.scene_text: At Gayasira, pilgrims offer food beneath the great Eternal Banyan beside the sacred Phalgu river to honor their ancestors.
The holy confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna at Prayaga glitters as sages gather where the ancient sacrifice of the Grandsire was once performed.
In the quiet forest of Naimisha, ascetics sit among sacred groves and rivers revered by gods and rishis.
